title: Sync ID, authentication and the HTTP client
summary: Define credentials and transport behavior, landing the shared server dependency before completing the client.

specReferences.heading: W5 · Sync ID, authentication and the HTTP client

produces: Diceware sync ID and shared normalizer
Unconditional base64url credential encoding and id_key definition
Authenticated HTTP client with typed outcomes
Device-scoped endpoint, ID, and device settings

conditions: Shared credential primitives land early enough for W10.
Non-ASCII credentials are issued over the real request path.
Redirect, certificate, decompression, and loopback protections pass.
First-time missing and previously used missing collections return distinct typed outcomes.
The client performs no replacement POST before caller confirmation.
completion.summary: Shared sync identity primitives and the endpoint-isolated authenticated HTTP client are shipped with explicit missing-store outcomes and transport safety guards.
evidence: PR #1157: core EFF diceware IDs, shared trim/NFC/lowercase normalization, advisory strength scoring, unconditional base64url credentials, HMAC storage-key derivation, typed HTTP outcomes, exact endpoint/loopback validation, same-origin manual redirects, platform TLS verification, and bounded gzip handling.

packages/compendium_core/test/sync/sync_id_test.dart covers structural bounds, generated IDs, normalized scoring, non-ASCII UTF-8 credentials, malformed credential rejection, normalized key agreement, and unconditional encoding.

app/test/sync/sync_http_client_test.dart exercises an issued non-ASCII Bearer request, foreign redirect refusal, untrusted certificate refusal before authorization, exact loopback rules, streaming gzip limits, first-time versus replacement-required 404 outcomes, conflict/rejection/rate-limit typing, and ETag handling. Mutation runs caught raw credentials, a missing Bearer scheme, permissive redirects, and omitted backup exclusions.
python3 tools/preflight.py passed 19 locally available gates on the final implementation head; Flutter/Dart PATH-dependent gates were visibly skipped.
